title: Israel and Morocco agree to exchange ambassadors
gist: Podcast episode page: Israel and Morocco agreed to exchange ambassadors; Lebanese President Joseph Aoun held talks in France on the UN peacekeeping force in Lebanon; and Algeria revoked Sky News Arabia's license amid a growing rift with the UAE.

insights.claim: Israel and Morocco agreed to exchange ambassadors, upgrading their diplomatic ties.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Abraham Accords-era normalization is holding despite regional war; supportive for Israel-Morocco trade and investment links.
insights.locator: Israel and Morocco agree to exchange ambassadors

insights.claim: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun is in France for talks on the UN peacekeeping force in Lebanon.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: The future of UN peacekeeping in south Lebanon affects Israel-Hezbollah border risk.
insights.locator: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun is in France

insights.claim: Algeria revoked the license of Sky News Arabia amid a growing rift with the UAE.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: A deteriorating Algeria-UAE relationship could spill into Gulf investment flows into North Africa.
insights.locator: Algeria revoked the license of Sky News Arabia
